pictures.name: QWS1-Night-Garden
pictures.prompt: The paradise garden at night under a silver moon: dark trees, a silent stream, deep blue shadows, everything still, and far off the one tree standing alone in its clearing. Hushed, a little uneasy. No people or human figures of any kind, no hands, no silhouettes, no faces. No angels, spirits or beings of any kind in any form, not even as figures of light, glowing shapes or wings. No animals, no serpent. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike, rich textiles and textures, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still. One tall 9:16 vertical picture, main subject in the middle. No text, no letters, no logos.
